communication_goal: 用单一变化验证假设并隔离故障原因。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure SOLID BLACK background, bright clean WHITE line art. Minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces, thin limbs, polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No colors, gradients, shading or photographic rendering. Single coherent scene, no panels. People and props central, approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on 0..1000 canvas. Generous blank space at top y<180, bottom y>850 and sides for later learning labels. Learning props recognizable and fully visible. Conversation gestures. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermark, readable code or writing. Simple abstract UI symbols allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure programmers sit at a desk with a simple laptop on LEFT. On the RIGHT foreground of the desk lies one large clearly recognizable detached data CABLE, a curved cord with a rectangular connector plug at EACH end. Both plugs and the entire curved cord are fully visible and isolated from hands. One programmer points toward the cable, other listens. No extra cables, no text.

coverage_review.scope: W056 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

image_review.summary: 通过：单幅双人黑底白线火柴人，底图无文字、学习道具可辨认；框选完整线缆及两端插头；故障原因仅为假设，不由外观判定。 其他3词保持语境标签，无编造动作或身份框。 实际1254像素尺寸的裁剪检查后修正框范围，加入边缘余量保护完整道具。
